subject: Order Form redlines: evidence handoff and feedback license logistics
messages:
From: Kari Jensen <kari.jensen@innovum.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <purchasing@innovum.ai>, Innovum Legal <legal@innovum.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on MSA/Order Form redlines (output & training)

Monica — thanks for the draft. Our legal and procurement teams reviewed the MSA + order form and pushed a few redlines we want to confirm with you before we proceed to signatures. High-level asks: 

1) Output ownership: Innovum prefers a clause that assigns productized output to us (we want clarity if Redwood will assert any title to derived product features).
2) Training/data use: we need explicit opt-out language for model training on our content, plus an evidence pathway (logs or attestations) that customer data will not be used to train models in hosted/dedicated modes.
3) Feedback license: we proposed a limited-purpose feedback license for telemetry and aggregated quality improvements. Redlines attached (Innovum_redlines.docx).

Could you: (a) confirm Redwood's tolerance for the output assignment request; (b) tell us what evidence you can provide about non-training guarantees and telemetry handling; and (c) indicate if you can accept a feedback license limited to anonymized, aggregated signal only?

We're looking to close this week if possible.

Thanks,
Kari Jensen
Head of Procurement, Innovum AI
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Kari Jensen <kari.jensen@innovum.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on MSA/Order Form redlines (output & training)

Kari — thanks for the clear summary and the redlines. Attaching our internal checklist for evidence (ConsentEvidenceChecklist.xlsx) so you can see what we typically provide. Quick responses while I pull the legal team in: 

- Output ownership: We generally cannot assign blanket ownership of Redwood model outputs in the MSA, but we can agree to a very targeted productization carveout in the order form for specific deliverables (exhibit A). If you can list the outputs you consider "productized" in the order form, we can scope it there.

- Training/data use: We can provide a contractual opt-out for training on your customer content (hosted + dedicated). For Private deployments (on-prem/VPC) we don't train on customer data by default. Evidence: we can provide procedural attestations, sampling of server logs showing training flags, and an exportable audit log for calls that were opt-out tagged. I'll have Legal confirm the exact artifacts.

- Feedback license: We can accept a limited, anonymized/aggregated feedback license restricted to model quality improvements and operational telemetry (no customer content used to create training datasets) — subject to legal sign-off on the draft clause.

Can we do a 20-minute joint call tomorrow to walk the redlines? If you have an order-form-level Exhibit A that lists the specific outputs you'd like carved out, please attach it to speed things up.

Thanks — looping Ben, Laura, and Rishi for the legal/ops details.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kari Jensen <kari.jensen@innovum.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on MSA/Order Form redlines (output & training)

Kari / Monica — quick commercial perspective. We've seen deals close faster when we offer: 

- A narrow productization carveout in the order form limited to "customer-authored product templates and user-facing generated assets" listed by name in Exhibit A.
- An explicit training opt-out tied to a paid "no-training" flag on the subscription (so we can operationalize billing and enforcement).
- Feedback license: agree to anonymized/aggregated telemetry only. As a concession, Redwood will accept a 12-month limited feedback license (non-exclusive, revocable) instead of perpetual, so Innovum has a guaranteed expiry if you prefer.

Suggested excerpt (for discussion with Laura): 
"Redwood shall have a non-exclusive, non-transferable, royalty-free license solely to use aggregated, anonymized telemetry and model performance signals derived from Customer usage for the purpose of improving Redwood's hosted inference service; such license shall exclude Customer content and shall terminate twelve (12) months after collection unless otherwise agreed in writing."

Happy to step into the call to align commercial/timeline.

-Ben
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kari Jensen <kari.jensen@innovum.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on MSA/Order Form redlines (output & training)

Kari — thanks for the redlines and Monica/Ben for the context. A few legal points: 

1) Output/productization carveout: Redwood cannot agree to a blanket assignment of outputs. We can negotiate targeted assignment for specific, named deliverables in Exhibit A (as Ben suggested). Please provide that exhibit with itemized outputs and we will draft compatible language.

2) Training opt-out & evidence: We will accept a contractual opt-out for training on Customer Content for hosted and dedicated offerings. For evidence, we can provide: 
  - A signed attestation describing processes and systems used to prevent training on opted-out content; 
  - Access to an exportable audit log showing request identifiers with "no-train" metadata for the relevant time window; 
  - A one-time snapshot report of retention and deletion policies for data in scope.

3) Feedback license: Laura's legal position is to keep the scope narrow and time-limited. I reviewed Ben's excerpt and propose a minor tweak to include a purpose limitation clause and a requirement that any use of aggregated signals does not permit reconstructing Customer content. Suggested revision: 

"Redwood may use aggregated, anonymized telemetry and performance signals derived from Customer usage solely to evaluate and improve Redwood's inference platform; such use shall expressly exclude any use that would enable training of models on Customer Content or reconstruction of Customer Content, and shall terminate twelve (12) months after collection unless renewed in writing."

Attached draft for review: Redwood_feedback_license_v2.docx. Please confirm whether Innovum's legal team can accept: (a) checklist evidence above; and (b) the time-limited feedback license language. If yes, we will incorporate final language into the Order Form and circulate for signature.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

1) Exhibit A: we've attached a short list of the outputs we want carved out (sent in a separate PDF to your procurement inbox).
2) Signing/timeline: Procurement would like to complete signatures by EOD Tuesday. Can Redwood circulate a final Order Form with the updated Exhibit A and the agreed feedback clause? We'll be ready to sign once we see the final text.

If you can send a DocuSign link to the agreed Order Form, we'll route internally. Appreciate the team moving quickly on this.

Best,
